hook.say: Africa's ten highest mountains. Half of them hide in one misty range!

outro.say: Is Mawenzi its own mountain? Comment below!

items.name: Ras Dashen
items.say: Number ten: Rahss Dah-shen, the roof of Ethiopia. 4550 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Ras Dashen, the roof of Ethiopia. 4,550 meters.

items.name: Mount Meru
items.say: Nine: Mount Meru, Kilimanjaro's little brother. 4566 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Mount Meru, Kilimanjaro's little brother. 4,566 meters.

items.name: Mount Gessi
items.say: Eight: Mount Jessie, in the Mountains of the Moon. 4715 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Mount Gessi, in the Mountains of the Moon. 4,715 meters.

items.name: Mount Emin
items.fact: The Congo side of the range
items.say: Seven: Mount Eh-meen, on the Congo side. 4798 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Mount Emin, on the Congo side. 4,798 meters.

items.name: Mount Baker
items.say: Six: Mount Baker, topped by Edward Peak. 4844 meters.
items.cap: Six: Mount Baker, topped by Edward Peak. 4,844 meters.

items.name: Mount Speke
items.say: Five: Mount Speke, named for an explorer who never climbed it. 4890 meters.
items.cap: Five: Mount Speke, named for an explorer who never climbed it. 4,890 meters.

items.name: Mount Stanley
items.say: Four: Mount Stanley, with glaciers near the equator. 5109 meters.
items.cap: Four: Mount Stanley, with glaciers near the equator. 5,109 meters.

items.name: Mawenzi
items.say: Three: Mah-wen-zee, Kilimanjaro's jagged second summit. 5148 meters.
items.cap: Three: Mawenzi, Kilimanjaro's jagged second summit. 5,148 meters.

items.name: Mount Kenya
items.fact: Rock spires of an old volcano
items.say: Two: Mount Kenya, spires of an ancient volcano. 5199 meters.
items.cap: Two: Mount Kenya, spires of an ancient volcano. 5,199 meters.

items.name: Kilimanjaro
items.say: And number one: Kilimanjaro! 5895 meters, the roof of Africa.
items.cap: And number one: Kilimanjaro! 5,895 meters, the roof of Africa.
